# Transfer libraries

These source trees are used by Manager's foreground transfer sessions:

- `libhaze`: [ITotalJustice/libhaze](https://github.com/ITotalJustice/libhaze), based on Atmosphère Haze. Its GPL licence and source notices are preserved.
- `ftpsrv`: [ITotalJustice/ftpsrv](https://github.com/ITotalJustice/ftpsrv). The source files identify the MIT licence and copyright holder; the licence text is included alongside them.

These are the local source snapshots used by the application. Their original Git commit IDs were not retained in this imported dependency folder. The repository commit pins the complete supplied trees. Neither dependency comes from MagicMonkei.
